info.title: DocIntel API
info.description: Upload invoices and receipts (PDF, images, Excel, CSV), follow their processing, review and correct the extracted records, search them and cross-verify them. Errors use the envelope `{"error": {"code", "message", "details"}}`. When `API_KEYS` is set every route except `/api/v1/health` needs `X-API-Key: <key>` or `Authorization: Bearer <key>`.

503.description: The database or the queue is not reachable

get.summary: Upload limits, accepted file types and the LLM in use

post.description:
Accept 1..``MAX_FILES_PER_REQUEST`` files in the multipart field ``files``.

Each file is identified by its content (PDF, PNG/JPEG/TIFF, XLSX/XLS, CSV), stored under a random name and
queued for processing. The response has one item per file, in request order: ``queued`` with the new document
and job ids (``duplicate_of_id`` when the same bytes were uploaded before), or ``rejected`` with an error code
(``unsupported_file_type``, ``empty_file``, ``file_too_large``). Rejected files create nothing.

413.description: The request is larger than the upload limits

422.description: No files, or more than MAX_FILES_PER_REQUEST

get.summary: Get a document with its records and issues

delete.summary: Delete a document, its results and its file
delete.description:
Deletes the document with its pages, records, issues, jobs, events and stored file. Refused (409) while a
worker is running a job for it (a job whose worker stopped sending heartbeats does not count); a queued job is
removed with the document and its worker finds nothing to do.

Other documents' records that shared an invoice number with the deleted records are reconciled again in the
same transaction, so their duplicate and cross-verification issues (and review / document status) no longer
point at the deleted document; re-uploads of the deleted file lose their ``DUPLICATE_FILE`` issue.

get.summary: Extracted text per page or sheet

get.description:
Every filter is optional and they combine with AND; text filters are case-insensitive substrings
(``invoice_number`` also matches the normalized number, so ``inv2024/1`` finds ``INV-2024-1``).

patch.description:
Set the given ``fields`` (``null`` clears one) and optionally replace all ``line_items``.

Amounts are decimal strings (``"1234.50"``), dates ``YYYY-MM-DD``, currency an ISO code. Each changed field is
recorded in the correction history with ``comment`` and the caller (``X-Actor`` header, else the API key
fingerprint), becomes ``source: manual`` with confidence 1.0, and the record is validated again: the response
carries the fresh issues and review status.

409.description: The document is queued or being processed

post.description:
Marks the record ``reviewed`` (by the caller, now) and updates the document status; approving a reviewed
record again changes nothing.

409.description: The document is queued or being processed

post.description:
Creates one new job per document whose status is ``failed`` (documents that already have a queued or running
job are skipped) and queues them after one commit.

get.description:
One hit per document or record, best first; ``snippet`` marks matches with « and ».

``match_type`` says which ranking found a hit: ``keyword``, ``semantic``, ``hybrid`` (both) or ``filter`` - a
blank ``q`` with filters lists the matching records newest first (score 0). Scores are comparable only within
one result list.

post.summary: Compare two records field by field
post.description:
Compare two records given by invoice id, or two documents given by document id.

Documents are paired by normalized invoice number (a single record on each side is compared directly). When
the documents share several invoice numbers, every pair is compared and stored and the response is the first
pair in record order; ``GET /cross-verifications?document_id=...`` lists them all. A pair has one stored
comparison: asking again (either way round) updates it, and ``left`` is the earlier upload unless the pair's
row already had the other orientation.

422.description: Not exactly one pair of ids, or nothing to pair

get.summary: Counts, issue breakdown, processing times and the LLM in use
get.description:
``llm.fallback_documents`` / ``llm.fallback_records``: how much of the processed data did not get the LLM
it was configured for (no provider, provider errors, refusals) and used the rules result instead.

max_request_mb.title: Max Request Mb
max_request_mb.description: Cap of one upload request body (all its files together), in MiB

CrossVerifyRequest.title: CrossVerifyRequest
CrossVerifyRequest.description: Two invoice ids, or two document ids whose records are paired by invoice number.

InvoiceFieldChanges.title: InvoiceFieldChanges
InvoiceFieldChanges.description: The editable fields; a field present in the body is set (``null`` clears it), absent fields are kept.

InvoicePatch.title: InvoicePatch
InvoicePatch.description: ``fields`` to change, an optional full replacement of ``line_items`` and a comment for the audit trail.

fallback_documents.title: Fallback Documents
fallback_documents.description: Documents for which the LLM was unavailable, failed or refused, so the rules result was used

fallback_records.title: Fallback Records
fallback_records.description: Records (of those documents) that used the rules result
